gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-hubot-sans: Hubot Sans opens its e wide and feels thoroughly modern, while Balsamiq Sans draws every curve and straight at a single stencil-cut width. Make the heading big and it stays lively.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-ar: IBM Plex Sans Arabic reads friendly and open, a plain sans with nothing to prove. Balsamiq Sans is the one to lean on for rope-like, expressive headlines, while the body just carries the words.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-de: Loose, rope-like curves that never knot at their ends give IBM Plex Sans Devanagari a modern, easygoing read. Balsamiq Sans is the bolder voice, with curves as heavy as its stems, like cord.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-he: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew reads contemporary and approachable, with uncrowded mouths on its s and c that let each word breathe. Balsamiq Sans adds bold, untapered energy above.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: Balsamiq Sans draws everything with no thick and thin, which makes the headline feel bold and hand-cut. IBM Plex Sans JP is the better one for text, ending each curve in a clean, open gap.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Chunky, bent-straw lettering up top, then a body that stays open at every curve end and never feels cramped. Balsamiq Sans has no pressure swell at the corners, while IBM Plex Sans KR keeps a lengthy read easy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: Balsamiq Sans bends its lines like a straw, bold and expressive. Shrink it and that cord-like charm gets lost, while IBM Plex Sans Thai, with c ends pointing apart like open pincers, wants more size.

IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped has curves that refuse to close. Next to it, Balsamiq Sans feels brash and expressive, every stroke finishing at the same measured thickness, so the two sit like loud and quiet voices.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-inclusive-sans: Chunky, expressive, cut like stencil channels. Balsamiq Sans is best at bold display moments, while Inclusive Sans, with round letters whose rims match the stems, carries the text with a professional, open-ended finish.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-inria-sans: Rounded, bold lettering with no pinched curves leads, then Inria Sans follows with tubular strokes like bent copper pipe. Balsamiq Sans feels like a stencil next to its see-through c openings.
